BIST DAILY STOCK BRIEF | October 31, 2026

MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 26.8% and narrow participation: only 1/8 sectors posted positive 1W returns. The weak breadth signals a fragile backdrop despite volatility remaining below the high-risk threshold.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom led at +1.26% for the week, while Construction & REIT was the least weak at -1.06%. KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) was in RECOVERY; TKFEN (1W: +9.85% | 1M: -19.01%) was in RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy & Chemicals (-9.71%) and Transportation (-7.36%) were the weakest sectors. GUBRF (1W: -21.58% | 1M: -32.59%) was in BELOW TREND; TAVHL (1W: -11.32% | 1M: -4.50%) was in BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) was in RECOVERY; TKFEN (1W: +9.85% | 1M: -19.01%) was in RECOVERY; ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) was in ABOVE TREND. FROTO (1W: +3.52% | 1M: -6.99%) and ENKAI (1W: +3.50% | 1M: -7.43%) were both in RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: -21.68% | 1M: -36.95%), GUBRF (1W: -21.58% | 1M: -32.59%), HEKTS (1W: -16.40% | 1M: -24.04%), EREGL (1W: -14.51% | 1M: -15.07%) and TRMET (1W: -11.06% | 1M: -19.92%) were all in BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) and TKFEN (1W: +9.85% | 1M: -19.01%) had the strongest weekly moves, both in RECOVERY. ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) was in ABOVE TREND, providing the clearest positive confirmation.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance fell 4.80% on the week, with all seven constituents negative. AKBNK (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -9.87%), GARAN (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -1.86%), ISCTR (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -6.41%) and YKBNK (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -4.22%) were all in BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry declined 6.20%; ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) was in ABOVE TREND, while FROTO (1W: +3.52% | 1M: -6.99%) and TOASO (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -16.97%) were in RECOVERY. EREGL (1W: -14.51% | 1M: -15.07%) was in BELOW TREND, highlighting the sector’s uneven performance.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals was the weakest sector, down 9.71% for the week and 17.34% for the month. TUPRS (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -5.71%), SASA (1W: -10.24% | 1M: -20.74%) and SISE (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -11.30%) were all in BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Keep risk measured and prioritize capital preservation while breadth remains at 1/8; avoid broad cyclical exposure and require confirmation before adding to rebound trades. Favor selective relative strength, while recognizing that even the weekly leaders largely remain in RECOVERY rather than confirmed uptrends.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Watch KONTR (1W: +12.08% | 1M: -18.14%) and TKFEN (1W: +9.85% | 1M: -19.01%) for follow-through from RECOVERY, and ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) for continuation of ABOVE TREND. FROTO (1W: +3.52% | 1M: -6.99%) is also worth monitoring for recovery confirmation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Technology & Telecom for breadth beyond its sole positive sector reading, and Construction & REIT for persistence in its relative outperformance. Energy & Chemicals remains a key downside-risk gauge after leading sector losses.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Specific XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided, so no price levels can be stated reliably. Watch for volatility moving above 40% or breadth improving from 1/8; either would materially change the risk assessment.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market is NEUTRAL, with 26.8% volatility but exceptionally narrow breadth at 1/8 sectors positive; sector performance remains broadly weak. Technology & Telecom led, and ASELS (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +5.91%) was in ABOVE TREND, while the sharp weakness in Energy & Chemicals and several heavy-industry names keeps downside risk elevated.
